entities.name: Ranalus
entities.description: A criminal vedalken rogue and former scholar from Esper who joined the Seekers of Carmot and later renounced Esper.

entities.name: Seekers of Carmot
entities.description: Group Ranalus joined to perform reconnaissance.

entities.name: Ethersworn
entities.description: Esper society whose etiquette Ranalus failed to respect.

entities.name: Sharuum
entities.description: The Sphinx Hegemon, rumored to have scolded Ranalus.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Jungle shard where Ranalus went undercover.

entities.name: Coatl
entities.description: A large Nayan snake that offered regenerative powers to Ranalus.

entities.name: Filigree Texts
entities.description: Principles of Esper that Ranalus repudiated.

events.summary: Ranalus, a troublesome student, becomes an outcast in Esper society.
events.quote: her attitude and actions led to her becoming somewhat of an outcast in Esper society.

events.summary: When war breaks out she volunteers for the Seekers of Carmot.
events.quote: she volunteered to join the Seekers of Carmot and perform reconnaissance duty

events.summary: In Naya she renounces Esper and extracts all etherium from her body with a coatl's regenerative help.
events.quote: She slowly extracted every thread and joint of etherium from her body

relations.quote: who joined the Seekers of Carmot to leave her shard
